projects.title: Log Analyzing System
projects.description: A comprehensive log analysis system built with Docker Compose, featuring real-time log generation, anomaly detection, and visualization using Elasticsearch, Kibana, and Grafana.
features: Log Generation: Simulates application logs with various levels
Log Analysis: Processes logs in real-time to detect anomalies
Storage & Indexing: Uses Elasticsearch for efficient log storage
Visualization: Multiple dashboards with Kibana and Grafana
Streaming: Optional Kafka integration for high-throughput log processing
projects.technologies: Docker Compose, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Grafana, Java, Python, Kafka
projects.fullDescription:
A comprehensive log monitoring and analysis system built with Docker Compose, featuring real-time log generation, anomaly detection, and visualization using Elasticsearch, Kibana, and Grafana.

This system provides end-to-end log management capabilities:
- Log Generation: Simulates application logs with various levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR)
- Log Analysis: Processes logs in real-time to detect anomalies
- Storage & Indexing: Uses Elasticsearch for efficient log storage and querying
- Visualization: Multiple dashboards with Kibana and Grafana
- Streaming: Optional Kafka integration for high-throughput log processing

The system consists of the following components:
- Log Generator: Java application that produces simulated logs
- Log Analyzer: Python service that processes logs and detects anomalies
- Elasticsearch: Search and analytics engine for log storage
- Kibana: Data visualization dashboard for Elasticsearch
- Grafana: Advanced metrics visualization platform
- Kafka (optional): Message broker for log streaming

projects.title: InsightBot: University Recommendation System
projects.description: An intelligent chatbot that assists international students in selecting the right university and timing their studies in the United States, providing tailored recommendations based on various factors.
features: Personalized university recommendations based on preferences
Cost of living analysis for different states
Weather and climate insights for regions
Job market trend analysis for various fields
Scholarship identification from universities and external sources
projects.technologies: Python, Streamlit, ChromaDB, OpenAI API, Python-docx, OpenWeather API
projects.fullDescription:
InsightBot (Comprehensive Master's Program Assistant for Student Success) is an intelligent chatbot that assists international students in selecting the right university and timing their studies in the United States. The system provides tailored recommendations based on factors such as field of study, cost of living, weather preferences, job market outlook, and university strengths for specific courses.

InsightBot helps international students make informed decisions through:
- Personalized university recommendations
- Cost of living analysis for different states
- Weather and climate insights
- Job market trend analysis for various fields
- Scholarship identification from universities and external sources

The system uses several components:
- Frontend: Streamlit web application
- Vector Database: ChromaDB for storing embeddings
- LLM Integration: OpenAI API for generating recommendations
- External Data: OpenWeather API for climate information
- Document Processing: Python-docx for handling document templates

projects.title: Social Media Influencer Analysis
projects.description: A detailed analysis of social media influencers, focusing on their impact on business marketing strategies across different platforms, categories, and regions.
features: Category Analysis: Analyzing popularity of different influencer categories
Regional Analysis: Understanding preferences across global regions
Engagement Analysis: Studying relationship between followers and engagement
Comprehensive Visualizations: Various plots to represent findings
Statistical Analysis: Identifying trends and anomalies
projects.technologies: Python, Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, NumPy
projects.fullDescription:
This project performs a detailed analysis of social media influencers, focusing on their impact on business marketing strategies. The analysis examines various aspects such as influencer category dominance, regional preferences, and engagement metrics across different social media platforms. The purpose is to provide insights that can help businesses optimize their influencer marketing strategies.

The analysis includes:
- Category Analysis: Analyzes the popularity of different influencer categories across the global and regional spectra.
- Engagement Analysis: Studies the relationship between follower counts and engagement rates to identify trends and anomalies.
- Visualizations: Includes several plots and graphs to visually represent the data and findings.

The project is implemented in Python using Jupyter Notebook with libraries such as pandas for data manipulation, matplotlib and seaborn for visualization, and numpy for numerical operations.
